runtime_result.later_progress: The same bounded run continued through EVENT_WRITE_SHD PM4 writes and native Vulkan frame submissions after both calls.

interpretation.supported: This is a boot-time volume-information/cleanup path that calls the current ReXGlue success stub twice with handle 0xF800003C. In the observed caller, the import's return value is ignored and execution continues to NtClose; this run then continued into guest PM4 and Vulkan submission.
interpretation.not_proven: This does not establish the correct general semantics of IoDismountVolumeByFileHandle, whether the no-op leaves a later-required volume mounted, or whether this API matters in other title states. It is not an observed blocker to reaching PM4 in this run.
